function first<T>(map: { [key: symbol]: T }): T { return map[Symbol.for('x')]; }
function values<T>(map: { [key: string]: T }): T[] { return Object.values(map); }
function numbers<T>(map: { [key: number]: T }): T { return map[1]; }
const k = Symbol();
const r1: string = first({ [k]: 2 });
const r2: number[] = values({ a: 1, [k]: 'x' });
const r3: number = numbers({ 1: 'a', b: 2 });
const typed: { a: number } = { a: 1 };
const r4: string[] = values(typed);
const both: { [key: symbol]: string; [key: string]: number } = {};
const r6: boolean = first(both);
console.log(r1, r2, r3, r4, r6);
